end.summary:
- Practised choosing exact or approximate values in everyday situations.
- Correctly identified that “lagbhag” signals an approximate value.
- Practised rounding large numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore.
- Gave 4 correct unaided rounding answers out of 6; teach-back was not yet passed.
- Explained why headlines may use approximate values for very large crowds.
end.parentNote: Asha practised exact versus approximate values and rounding large numbers with Ayaan. They used the clue “lagbhag” correctly and explained why a large crowd may be reported approximately. Ayaan had some rounding mix-ups with place values and rounding to lakh or crore; these were not consistently corrected by the end. At home, ask them to round a few numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore and explain which digit they checked.
